anomalies.observed: On the root sheet, in the 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' block, the two global labels NET0006 and NET0017 are both attached to the same node. That node also carries the 22 nF capacitor C19 to GND and the 1 kΩ series resistor R2, whose other end runs to the touch electrode A1 pin 'BTN' (pin 1). The two MCU-side nets are therefore shorted together at the electrode node, and the sampling capacitor sits on that merged net rather than on its own pin.
anomalies.expected: Per the spec the electrode and the TSC sampling capacitor must be on two separate MCU pins/nets: PB5 drives the electrode through the 1 kΩ series resistor, while the 22 nF sampling capacitor is connected from PB7 to GND. The two nets must not be joined.

evidence.quote: TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin "BTN" (the touch electrode)
TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group
Capacitive Touch Button (TSC) block, root sheet: global labels "NET0006" and "NET0017" drawn on the same wire that feeds C19 (22n) and R2 (1k) toward A1 (TSC) pin 'BTN'

anomalies.impact: The TSC electrode-drive pin and the sampling-capacitor pin are shorted and the 22 nF sampling capacitor is placed on the electrode net, so the STM32 Touch Sensing Controller charge-transfer measurement cannot work; the capacitive touch button will be non-functional or erratic.

parsed.summary: One anomaly found: in the Capacitive Touch (TSC) block the electrode net (NET0006) and the sampling-capacitor net (NET0017) are joined on the same node, shorting two TSC group pins and mis-placing the 22 nF sampling cap, contrary to the spec's separate PB5 (electrode) and PB7 (sampling-capacitor) wiring.
